name: Krinkov's Kustom Music Pack
teaser:
Music to annihilate your enemies with. Over 67 hand picked tracks to prepare to decimate Scavs and PMCs alike.

Music from Trepang 2, Geneburn, DOOM and Postal Redux.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OHPdODKf8W4&
description_html:
Music pack containing music from Trepang 2, Doom 2016&Eternal, Postal Redux and Geneburn.

Perfect for preparing to eliminate your enemies

Credit to: Brandon for producing this Heavenly Soundtrack for Trepang 2, Mick Gordan for producing the hell of a soundtrack that is DOOM (2016 & Eternal), Sean Terry and Takumi Sekiguchi Sloan for the Toxic music of the horror of Postal Redux.
